Web (Recharge 5-6).description: Ranged attack +4; range 30/60 ft.; Block DC 12. On an unblocked strike, the target is Pinned by webbing. As an action it can make the source DC 11 Strength check to escape. The web can also be destroyed: AC 10, HP 5, vulnerability to fire, immunity to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage (existing SRD Giant Spider web alternative).

Acid Breath (Recharge 5-6).description: Action; 15-foot line, 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line makes a DC 11 Dexterity save, taking 5d8 acid damage on a failure, half on a success. This is a saving-throw area, so it cannot be Blocked. The repeated +4 attack field is not a second attack roll.

notes: Source spelling 'Balckspawn' is retained so saved campaign names remain searchable. Empty linked ability IDs do not identify a rule; no unidentified feature was silently imported. Missing web-object and half-on-save details use existing SRD Giant Spider / black dragon breath conventions.
CR 3 is a provisional Vara encounter estimate based on this converted creature's HP, defenses, attacks and control effects; validate against party performance in play.

Shadow Camouflage.description: While in dim light or darkness, the creature can take Hide as a bonus action and has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Existing alternative: the complete Shadow Camouflage trait of the Nightshade Zombie in the same campaign export.

Sunlight Weakness.description: While in sunlight, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws. Existing alternative: the complete Nightshade Zombie sunlight trait replaces the copied Turn Resistance text.

Bite.description: Melee attack +14, reach 10 ft., Block DC 22. Unblocked strike: 3d8+9 piercing damage. A Large or smaller target must make the source DC 20 Dexterity save or be swallowed. Swallowed creatures are Blinded and Pinned with total cover from outside. At the start of the nightcrawler's turn, each takes 6d6 necrotic damage and makes DC 17 Constitution save; on failure its HP maximum falls by the necrotic damage taken until a long rest. At HP maximum 0 it dies, rises as a Nightshade Zombie on its own initiative, and is regurgitated within 10 ft. Taking at least 30 damage in one turn from inside forces the nightcrawler to make DC 21 Constitution save at that turn's end or regurgitate all swallowed creatures Prone within 10 ft. On its death, escape takes 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone. Size/trigger uses the existing SRD Purple Worm swallow alternative; campaign necrotic effects remain.

Stinger.description: Melee attack +14, reach 10 ft., Block DC 22. Unblocked strike: 3d6+9 piercing damage. Then DC 20 Constitution save: 12d6 poison damage on failure, half on success. Existing SRD Purple Worm stinger supplies the omitted save outcome.

Swallowed.name: Swallowed (ongoing effect)
Swallowed.description: This is the Bite's ongoing stomach effect, not an additional action. Resolve it at the start of the nightcrawler's turn as described in Bite; do not deal the damage twice.

Summon Undead (1/day).description: Action; once per day choose one source group: 1d8+8 Shadows, 1d4+2 Nightshade Zombies, 1d4+2 Wraiths, or 1d4 Dread Specters. They appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 ft., act as allies, and cannot summon or create other creatures. They remain for 1 minute, until they or the summoner die, or until dismissed by the summoner as an action. These missing procedure/range/control/duration details use the existing 5e Nightcrawler Summon Undead alternative by rferries; campaign summon choices and quantities are retained.

add_actions.name: Multiattack (existing alternative)
add_actions.description: Makes one Bite attack and one Stinger attack, using the existing SRD Purple Worm action sequence.

notes: Empty Shadow Camouflage and the duplicated Sunlight Weakness text use complete traits from the supplied Nightshade Zombie. Bite size limits and Multiattack use the SRD Purple Worm alternative. No creature stats were invented.
Summon Undead procedure uses the existing 5e Nightcrawler adaptation by rferries, retaining the original campaign group choices and quantities.

Shadow Stealth.description: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can Hide as a bonus action (existing SRD Shadow trait).

Strength Drain.description: Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., Block DC 12. Unblocked strike: 2d6+2 necrotic damage and Strength reduced by 1d4. The target dies if its Strength becomes 0; otherwise the reduction ends after a short or long rest. A non-evil humanoid killed by this attack rises as a shadow 1d4 hours later. The unsupported campaign 'DC 8' annotation is replaced by the complete existing SRD Shadow ability, which has no saving throw.

Life Drain.description: Melee attack +6, reach 5 ft., Block DC 14. Unblocked strike: 4d8+3 necrotic damage; DC 14 Constitution save or HP maximum reduced by damage taken until a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum becomes 0. Existing SRD Wraith supplies the missing duration and death clause.

Create Specter.description: Action; target a humanoid corpse within 10 ft. that died violently no longer than 1 minute ago. Its spirit rises as a Specter in its space or the nearest empty space under the wraith's control. It can control no more than seven specters this way. Existing complete SRD Wraith ability.

Life Drain.description: Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., Block DC 12. Unblocked strike: 3d6 necrotic damage; DC 10 Constitution save or HP maximum reduced by damage taken until a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum becomes 0. Missing duration/death wording uses the existing SRD Specter ability.

Melee attack +9, reach 5 ft., Block DC 17. Unblocked strike: 14d8 necrotic damage; DC 16 Constitution save or HP maximum reduced by damage taken until a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum becomes 0. Campaign damage and DC are retained; missing duration/death wording uses existing SRD Specter Life Drain.

Aggresive.description: As a bonus action, move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see. Existing SRD Orc Aggressive supplies the empty trait.

Life Drain.description: Melee attack +9, reach 5 ft., Block DC 17. Unblocked strike: 6d8 necrotic damage; DC 17 Constitution save or HP maximum reduced by damage taken until a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum becomes 0. Campaign damage/DC retained; missing duration/death wording uses existing SRD Wraith Life Drain.

Withering Touch.description: Melee attack +16, reach 10 ft., Block DC 24. Unblocked strike: 8d6+7 necrotic damage; DC 22 Constitution save or HP maximum reduced by that necrotic damage until a long rest. A target reduced to HP maximum 0 dies and becomes a Nightshade Zombie as described by Negative Energy Aura. Missing HP-reduction duration uses existing SRD Wraith Life Drain.

Death Ray.description: Action; range 120 ft.; DC 22 Constitution save. Failure: 13d8+30 necrotic damage; success: half damage. If the save fails, reduce HP maximum by necrotic damage taken until a long rest. At HP maximum 0 the target dies and becomes a Nightshade Zombie as described by Negative Energy Aura. Saving-throw effect; cannot be Blocked. Missing duration uses existing SRD Wraith Life Drain.

Hitpoint reduction.name: HP reduction (rider)
Hitpoint reduction.description: The source rider is incorporated into Withering Touch and Death Ray. It is not a separate action and does not apply a second HP reduction.

Summon Nightcrawler.name: Summon Nightcrawler (Recharge 6)
Summon Nightcrawler.description: Action; summon one Nightcrawler into an unoccupied space within the campaign's 60-ft. range. It fights at the atropal's command for up to 1 hour. Existing alternative: the published SpiralWorlds Atropal Summon Nightcrawler supplies the missing count, control and duration; the campaign's Recharge 6 is retained.

legendary_actions.name: Legendary action budget
legendary_actions.description: 3 per round. Use one option at the end of another creature's turn; regain the budget at the start of its own turn.

legendary_actions.name: Wail (3 actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each creature within 120 ft. that hears the wail makes a DC 22 Constitution save or gains 1 Fatigue. Saving-throw effect; cannot be Blocked.

notes: Summon Nightcrawler's omitted details use an existing published 5e alternative, explicitly identified. Its Recharge 6 and range come from the campaign export. The separately listed HP-reduction row is a rider, not another action.

Claw (2x).description: Make two claw attacks as one Attack action, each +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., Block DC 12. Each unblocked strike deals 1d8+2 bludgeoning damage and Grapples the target (escape DC 12 Strength/Athletics or Dexterity/Acrobatics as an action). One target per claw; it cannot attack a different target with an occupied claw. Existing SRD Giant Scorpion supplies missing claw occupancy/escape procedure.

Sting.description: Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., Block DC 12. Unblocked strike: 1d10+2 piercing damage; DC 12 Constitution save or 4d10 poison damage, half on success. Existing SRD Giant Scorpion supplies missing save outcome.

Vine throw (Recharge 5-6).description: Action; existing alternative: SRD Giant Spider Web with the source's 60-ft. range and DC 15. Use its +5 ranged attack, Block DC 13; an unblocked strike Pins the target in vines. The target can spend an action and make DC 15 Strength check to escape. The vines can be destroyed: AC 10, HP 5, vulnerable to fire; immune to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage. These are explicit replacements for the source's unspecified attack/save mode.

notes: The source's Huge/Gargantuan Osmosis damage increases are not fully specified. For those advanced forms use the existing SRD Enlarge effect: double size and add 1d4 weapon damage, retaining the source's stated 3d10 poison rider only at the 760-HP threshold. This is a sourced provisional growth alternative, not an invented dice progression.

Claws.description: Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., Block DC 12. Unblocked strike: 2d4+2 slashing damage. A target other than an elf or undead makes a DC 10 Constitution save or becomes Paralyzed for 1 minute; it repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on success. The repeat-save procedure is specific to this ability and applies despite the general Paralyzed condition. Missing duration/escape uses the existing SRD Ghoul ability.

Bite.description: Melee attack +7, reach 5 ft., Block DC 15. Unblocked strike: 1d4+4 piercing damage. DC 13 Constitution save or Paralyzed for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn to end it. The source's 3d6-necrotic-per-turn rider applies at the start of the affected creature's turns while this effect lasts. Existing SRD Ghoul supplies the missing duration/repeated-save procedure; that procedure is a specific exception to general Paralyzed saves.

Gorge.description: Action; range 5 ft. Target makes DC 15 Strength save or is Grappled; it then makes DC 16 Constitution save or is Paralyzed for 1 minute with end-of-turn repeated saves to end the paralysis. On a failed Strength save it takes 3d6 necrotic damage and the ogre ghoul regains equal HP. Missing paralysis timing uses the existing SRD Ghoul alternative. Grapple escape uses the source DC 15, as an action Strength/Athletics or Dexterity/Acrobatics check. This saving-throw ability cannot be Blocked.

notes: The omitted type of the life-draining 3d6 Gorge/ongoing Bite rider uses necrotic damage from the existing SRD Wraith Life Drain alternative; source dice and full healing are retained.

Drion has no recorded fighter level. Second Wind uses the existing Champion NPC's fixed 20 HP recovery; Rallying Cry uses the existing Knight Leadership action. The single-use Action Surge recharge uses the complete base SRD feature. No fighter level is inferred from attack bonuses or HP.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind (Champion alternative)
Second Wind.description: Bonus action; regain 20 HP. Regain this use after a short or long rest, using Vara rest durations. This is the published Champion NPC's fixed Second Wind, replacing the unknown fighter-level formula.

Action Surge.description: Once per short or long rest, take one additional action on your turn. This grants no extra bonus action or reaction. Uses the existing basic Action Surge rule; higher-level extra uses are not granted.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry (Knight Leadership alternative)
Rallying Cry.description: Action; once per short or long rest, activate Leadership for 1 minute. When a nonhostile creature Drion can see within 30 ft. makes an attack roll or saving throw, it may add 1d4 if it can hear and understand him. Only one Leadership die can apply to a roll. The effect ends if Drion is Incapacitated. Uses the existing Knight action instead of a healing formula based on an unrecorded fighter level.

Great Weapon Master.description: On your turn, after an unblocked melee critical strike or reducing a creature to 0 HP with a melee weapon, you may make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Before attacking with a proficient heavy melee weapon, you may take -5 to the attack roll to add +10 damage on an unblocked strike. Preserve this explicit creature feature; it does not add an extra bonus action.

Death Giant.block: 1 pool / +14 check (STR +7, trained armor +4, Protection 3); armor floor 1

fields.armor_rules: Source splint uses existing Vara Splint armor suit: Block 1, Protection 3, Physical reduction 1, Bulk 8, Slow 3. Source AC 17 and speed 40 ft. are retained as fixed creature statistics.

add_actions.name: Release Soul
add_actions.description: Action; expend one collected soul and choose one source benefit. Guide: advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Harm: make one Death Shard attack; an unblocked strike deals an additional 2d10 necrotic damage and forces a DC 15 Constitution save or Paralyzed until the end of the target's next turn. Heal: regain 4d10 HP. Trap: create one soul stone containing that soul; only one soul stone can exist at a time. The current Resurrect spell is the identified existing alternative to the unavailable Wish spell for restoring a soul trapped this way; on successful restoration the stone is destroyed. Source benefits, dice and durations are retained.

add_actions.name: Consume Soul (existing alternative)
add_actions.description: Action; spend one collected soul, or one soul stone held by the giant (destroying the stone as specified by the source). Use the existing current Occult Harvest burn-soul option: restore 3d10 HP to yourself or one undead within 10 ft. The soul is consumed. This supplies the omitted Consume Soul effect with an identified existing rule.

notes: Release Soul benefits were already present in the supplied HTML notes and are promoted without changing their dice. Standard action timing makes the source activation explicit. The undefined Consume Soul uses the existing Occult Harvest burn-soul alternative, and the absent Wish reference uses existing Resurrect with its current costs and requirements.

Rage.name: Rage (Berserker Bloodied Frenzy alternative)
Rage.description: While at or below half maximum HP, Miratrin has advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. This is the existing Berserker Bloodied Frenzy trait. It replaces the incomplete class-level Rage package, so it requires no invented barbarian level, Rage damage bonus or use pool.

Hammering Horns.description: Immediately after an unblocked melee strike made as part of the Attack action, use a bonus action to shove a creature within 5 ft. that is no more than one size larger. It makes a DC 14 Strength save; failure pushes it up to 10 ft. away. DC 14 uses the source feature formula and printed STR +3 / attack proficiency +3.

Headman's Chop.description: When a creature falls Prone within your melee reach, you may spend your reaction to make an opportunity attack against it. When you have advantage on an attack against a Prone creature, you may reroll one of those dice once and use the new roll.

Bite (Rage)(Magical).name: Bite (Bloodied; magical)
Bite (Rage)(Magical).description: Available only while at or below half maximum HP, using the existing Bloodied Frenzy condition as the replacement for Rage. Melee attack +6, reach 5 ft., Block DC 14. Unblocked strike: 1d8 piercing damage; Miratrin regains 3 HP. This magical natural attack retains the campaign damage and healing.

notes: The source Rage text requires an unrecorded barbarian level to determine damage and uses. It is replaced in full by the existing official Berserker Bloodied Frenzy trait; its bloodied state also replaces the Rage prerequisite on the printed Bite. The original class Rage remains in the source comparison.

Food storage.description: Can survive 14 days without food and 7 days without water before deprivation applies.

Heart of Fire.name: Heart of Fire
Heart of Fire.description: A creature touching Papaya, or landing an unblocked melee strike against her while within 5 ft., takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. This contact damage has no separate attack roll.

Twinned Spell (6x).name: Twinned Spell
Twinned Spell (6x).description: When casting a spell that targets one creature, spend 3 MP to target one additional creature within the spell's range. Reduce the cost by 1 for an Enchantment spell.

Flash Recall.name: Flash Recall
Flash Recall.description: When casting a known spell, spend 2 MP to cast it as a bonus action instead of an action. Reduce the cost by 1 for a Divination spell. Shares the same Metamagic pool.

fields.metamagic: 6 MP maximum; restore 1d4+1 MP each rest and all MP after a long rest.

notes: Papaya's unrecorded sorcerer level cannot supply Heart of Fire damage. The existing Azer Heated Body trait supplies a complete fire-themed alternative. Her current Metamagic options use the printed current class formula and share one six-point pool. Food storage uses the published Camel Constitution 14 as an explicit capacity baseline compatible with her +2 modifier, without claiming that exact source score is known.

Channel Divinity: Rhonas' Blessing (1x).description: One shared Channel Divinity use, restored after a short or long rest (existing base SRD Channel Divinity recharge). After seeing your Strength attack roll, ability check or save but before its outcome is declared, spend the use for +10 to that roll. Alternatively, as a reaction after a creature within 30 ft. makes such a Strength roll, grant it +10 before the outcome is declared. These are the source's fixed effects; both options share the same use with Destroy Undead.

Destroy Undead (1x).description: Action; spend the same Channel Divinity use as Rhonas' Blessing and present your holy symbol. Undead that can see or hear you within 30 ft. make a DC 14 Wisdom save, using the creature's printed spell save DC. On failure, an undead of CR 1/2 or lower is destroyed, as explicitly printed in the source. Other failed targets are turned for 1 minute or until they take damage: move as far away as possible, do not willingly approach within 30 ft., take no reactions, and use actions only to Dash or escape an effect preventing movement (Dodge if no escape route exists). This saving-throw effect cannot be Blocked. The shared use returns after a short or long rest.

notes: Both printed 1x Channel Divinity options share the existing single base Channel Divinity pool and SRD short/long-rest recharge, rather than receiving independent unlimited uses. Destroy Undead uses the already printed spell DC 14 and source CR 1/2 threshold; no cleric level is inferred.

Alternatively the existing Chain item can be broken: 10 HP, or a DC 20 Strength check to burst it. Unwavering Mark.description: After landing an unblocked melee weapon strike, the gnoll may mark the target until the end of the gnoll's next turn. The mark ends early if the gnoll is Incapacitated or dies, or someone else marks the target. While the target is within 5 ft. of the gnoll, it has disadvantage on attack rolls that do not target the gnoll. The missing trigger and duration use the existing Cavalier Unwavering Mark feature; no unrecorded fighter-level retaliation is added.
